messages: tanya: Heads up from design review 1: our in-console help header reads 'Guides' but the product nav + docs site use 'Docs'. This shows up in screenshots we use in onboarding and support emails. omar: odd. Where does 'Guides' appear exactly? tanya: top-right help button -> side panel title, also the keyboard shortcut tooltip says 'Open Guides (Ctrl+K)'. zhen: prefer 'Docs' as canonical. 'Guides' implies step-by-step; we already have a Tutorials section that uses that word. isabel: UX implication: search placeholder should match too. If we change the header, also change the placeholder and tooltip text. Also check mobile layout where header truncates to just 'Gds' right now. kevin-analytics: analytics currently tracks events: help_open, guide_click, docs_link. That's a mess. Recommend canonicalizing to docs.panel_open, docs.search, docs.open_console. Use lowercase 'docs' for keys. lex-bot: lexicon scan result -> occurrences: 'Docs' variants: 21 (site + nav); 'Guides' variants: 6 (console + onboarding); 'Tutorials': 4. CSV: /design/lexicon_audit_1767809999.csv tanya: good. Action items I propose: 1) rename panel header to 'Docs', 2) update placeholder to 'Search Docs and Guides', 3) update keyboard tooltip to 'Open Docs (Ctrl+K)', 4) add per-article 'Open in Console' contextual link, 5) run i18n sweep for translated strings. omar: small copy concern: placeholder 'Search Docs and Guides' might be too long for mobile. Maybe 'Search Docs' and rely on category filters. zhen: agree with omar. 'Search Docs' is concise and discoverable. We can surface 'Guides' as a filter chip inside results. isabel: accessibility: when panel opens focus must go to the search input. screenreader should announce 'Dialog, Docs'. ensure the CTA 'Open in Console' has aria-label including destination name and mentions it opens in new tab. kevin-analytics: telemetry addendum: include `source='help_panel'` and `target_route` in click payloads, and mark pre-change events with legacy key map to allow retroactive joins. lex-bot: added checklist to /boards/product: Unify header copy, Update search placeholder, Keyboard tooltip, Add per-article CTA, i18n sweep, Analytics rename, Mobile truncation fix, A11y pass. tanya: deployment plan: patch on staging -> a11y + analytics QA -> canary 5% orgs for 48h -> roll. We'll watch search query composition and support mentions for 14 days. omar: for redirects, we have a few deep links to /guides/*. ops prefers server-side 301s for SEO. Example nginx snippet: ``` location ~ ^/guides/(.*)$ { return 301 /docs/$1; } ``` plus SPA client router rule emitting deprecation event. zhen: i18n note: translators already have a batch job next week. please bump priority for the changed keys; otherwise localized console will show mixed terms. isabel: I'll run the screenreader pass and mobile touch target checks once the PR is up. Add me as reviewer. kevin-analytics: I'll spearhead the event renames and a lightweight mapping layer to backfill historical metrics. lex-bot: created PR template: include strings changed, selectors to update, analytics mapping, redirects, and acceptance criteria: header text, placeholder, keyboard tooltip, CTA presence for console users, i18n keys updated, a11y checks passed. tanya: thanks all. small example snippet for the CTA (feel free to paste in PR): ``` Open in Console ``` omar: I'll own the console change. ETA: next Wednesday. will post screenshots and smoke test results. zhen: i'll handle mobile truncation fix and i18n key bump. kevin-analytics: leaving a note to QA: assert telemetry event names and payloads before/after. isabel: will do a11y review Friday. lex-bot: tasks moved to sprint board: product/docs-lexicon-unify. tanya: perfect. closing the loop once canary metrics look stable :thumbsup:
